Go SDK v3

A typed client for the v3 REST API, for Go 1.18+.

Breaking changes in v3

The next major release will introduce breaking changes to the SDK API. Please review the migration guide if you are planning to upgrade.

Install

terminal bash 
go get github.com/godzilla-io/sdk-go

Create a client

main.go go 
package main

import (
	"os"
	"github.com/godzilla-io/sdk-go"
)

func main() {
	client := godzilla.NewClient(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY"))
}

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

create_pipeline.go go 
pipeline, err := client.Pipelines.Create(ctx, &godzilla.CreatePipelineRequest{
	Name:                    "ingest-orders",
	SourceConnectorID:       "conn_pg_orders",
	DestinationConnectorID:  "conn_snowflake_dw",
})
if err != nil {
	panic(err)
}

Handling failed events

Wraps the replay action described in Handling errors & retries:

replay.go go 
err := client.Events.Replay(ctx, "evt_8f2c1a90")
if err != nil {
	panic(err)
}
Context support

All client methods accept a context.Context parameter for timeout, cancellation, and request tracing.

Node.js SDK v3

A thin, typed wrapper around the v3 REST API for Node.js and TypeScript projects.

Breaking changes in v3

The next major release will introduce breaking changes to the SDK API. Please review the migration guide if you are planning to upgrade.

Install

terminal bash 
npm install @godzilla/sdk

Create a client

client.ts typescript 
import { Godzilla } from "@godzilla/sdk";

const godzilla = new Godzilla({ apiKey: process.env.GODZILLA_API_KEY });

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

create-pipeline.ts typescript 
const pipeline = await godzilla.pipelines.create({
  name: "ingest-orders",
  sourceConnectorId: "conn_pg_orders",
  destinationConnectorId: "conn_snowflake_dw",
});

Listening for webhooks

The SDK includes a signature-verification helper for webhook payloads:

verify.ts typescript 
import { verifyWebhookSignature } from "@godzilla/sdk";

const isValid = verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, signatureHeader, webhookSecret);
Retries are built in

The SDK retries idempotent requests (GET, and POST with an Idempotency-Key) automatically on 429 and 5xx responses using the same backoff the API itself uses.

Python SDK v3

A typed client for the v3 REST API, for Python 3.9+.

Breaking changes in v3

The next major release will introduce breaking changes to the SDK API. Please review the migration guide if you are planning to upgrade.

Install

terminal bash 
pip install godzilla-sdk

Create a client

client.py python 
from godzilla import Godzilla

godzilla = Godzilla(api_key=os.environ["GODZILLA_API_KEY"])

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

create_pipeline.py python 
pipeline = godzilla.pipelines.create(
    name="ingest-orders",
    source_connector_id="conn_pg_orders",
    destination_connector_id="conn_snowflake_dw",
)

Replaying dead-lettered events

Wraps the replay action described in Handling errors & retries:

replay.py python 
godzilla.events.replay("evt_8f2c1a90")
Async support

Every method has an async counterpart under godzilla.aio for use with asyncio-based applications.

verify.ts typescript 
import { verifyWebhookSignature } from "@godzilla/sdk";

const isValid = verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, signatureHeader, webhookSecret);
Retries are built in

The SDK retries idempotent requests (GET, and POST with an Idempotency-Key) automatically on 429 and 5xx responses using the same backoff the API itself uses.

🌋 Godzilla Docs
  • Go SDK

Python SDK v3

A typed client for the v3 REST API, for Python 3.9+.

Breaking changes in v3

The next major release will introduce breaking changes to the SDK API. Please review the migration guide if you are planning to upgrade.

Install

terminal bash 
pip install godzilla-sdk

Create a client

client.py python 
from godzilla import Godzilla

godzilla = Godzilla(api_key=os.environ["GODZILLA_API_KEY"])

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

create_pipeline.py python 
pipeline = godzilla.pipelines.create(
    name="ingest-orders",
    source_connector_id="conn_pg_orders",
    destination_connector_id="conn_snowflake_dw",
)

Replaying dead-lettered events

Wraps the replay action described in Handling errors & retries:

replay.py python 
godzilla.events.replay("evt_8f2c1a90")
Async support

Every method has an async counterpart under godzilla.aio for use with asyncio-based applications.
